Wrong copied CVE header. The file targets InduSoft TCP/1234 and sends the exact byte sequence/padding published in TRA-2018-07 for CVE-2018-8840. CVE-2019-3946 is instead Fuji V-Server UDP/8005, so must not inherit this file.

A genuine two-vulnerability chain. Header and operations explicitly use CVE-2018-15707 reflected XSS to capture credentials, then CVE-2018-15705 WADashboard writeFile traversal to upload ASP. Official records for both reference the same researcher advisory and ExploitDB entry. Do not attach CVE-2018-15706 readFile bug from the broader advisory.

CVE-2015-8277 occurs only in credit URLs for reused packet checksum helper functions. Main code constructs message 282 for lmadmin DoS, matching TRA-2020-28 and CVE-2020-12080. The older CVE covers different opcodes and must not inherit this reproduction.

The researcher advisory directly links this file for the GPON usb_Form stack overflow. File main payload overwrites clientusername at that endpoint, matching CVE-2019-3921. CVE-2018-10561 is mentioned as an authentication-bypass prerequisite or related extension; this review does not establish an independent mapping to that earlier CVE.
Source targets DevKit Pro original_user_id/revert_switch (CVE-2026-14378), not Divi Membership paypal_param (CVE-2026-19660).
